description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing surveys within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving survey lists, individual surveys, creating survey entries, retrieving client survey overviews, survey entries, registering surveys, and deleting survey entries.

classes.name: SurveyApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for survey operations in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all registered surveys.

methods.name: retrieveSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific survey by name.

methods.name: createDatatableEntry
methods.description: Creates a new entry in a survey table (fills out a survey).

methods.name: getClientSurveyOverview
methods.description: Retrieves survey score overview for a specific client.

methods.name: getSurveyEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey entry for a client.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a survey with an application table.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes a specific survey entry for a client.
